Free chess tournament manager for macOS and Windows. See the [arbiter's manual](https://github.com/Inad-Tech-World/chess_organizer/blob/main/docs/arbiter-manual.md).

## Download

| System | File |
|---|---|
| macOS 11 or later (Intel and Apple silicon) | `Chess.Organiser_<version>_universal.dmg` |
| Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit) | `Chess.Organiser_<version>_x64-setup.exe` (or the `.msi` for managed installs) |

## First start

These installers are not yet signed, so the operating system warns the first time.

- **macOS:** open the `.dmg` and drag Chess Organiser to Applications. The first time you open it, macOS says it cannot verify the app. Click **Done**, then go to System Settings › Privacy & Security, scroll down and click **Open Anyway**.
- **Windows:** if SmartScreen says "Windows protected your PC", click **More info**, then **Run anyway**.

This build does not update itself. Download newer versions from this page.
